import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    ar = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]
    br = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]

    mx_wins = 0
    mx_loses_or_draw = 0
    for i in range(3):
        mx_wins += min(ar[i], br[(i + 1) % 3])
        mx_lose = min(br[i], ar[(i + 1) % 3])
        mx_draw = min(br[i], ar[i])
        mx_loses_or_draw += min(br[i], mx_lose + mx_draw)

    print(n - mx_loses_or_draw)
    print(mx_wins)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
